review_candidates.title: Urgent Field Support (UFS) Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft, tactical reconnaissance radars, and advanced high-resolution surveillance systems. We have an exciting opportunity for an Urgent Field Support (UFS) Engineer in our Engineering Field Support (EFS) group at GA-ASI. UFS needs talented, driven, and adaptive engineers to keep our systems operational, one aircraft or Ground Control Station (GCS) at a time. Under general supervision with limited review, this position is responsible for determining and developing effective approaches to quickly solve a wide range of difficult, multidisciplinary engineering problems encountered on fielded systems. This primarily involves creation of engineering troubleshooting, repair, or rework recommendations that may be novel or outside the scope of released technical documentation. Investigations are typically conducted in an expeditious manner with functional engineering departments to determine root cause and appropriate corrective action. After investigations are completed, findings and corrective actions are documented and communicated directly to our customers and engineering staff in accordance with contracted deliverables. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Be able to work a rotating, periodic on-call schedule for off-hour and weekend support. Support Operations Center activities including shift coverage during planned working hours. Obtain and maintain technical system-level knowledge of GA-ASI aircraft, ground control stations, and associated hardware, including related operational procedure and maintenance processes. Robust knowledge of systems and procedures is required to understand discrepancies and generate appropriate corrective action. Direct investigations of anomalies based on information provided by customers, available technical information, manuals, and standard scientific and engineering principles. Interface with design engineers, test engineers, program management, maintenance technicians, technical writers, pilots, and other professional staff to coordinate operational or maintenance workarounds, improved procedures, software updates, or hardware modifications as required in response to field incidents and anomalies. Author engineering memorandums and presentations for anomaly investigations to customers, GA-ASI technical staff, and executive leadership. Memorandums are a primary deliverable and may be required under an emergency timeframe. Direct the activities of designers and technicians and potentially lead and direct the activities of less experienced professional staff. Represent the organization to GA-ASI’s customers in describing solutions to technical issues associated with specific anomalies. Ensure that findings from any investigation are well-documented, and that required platform improvements or workarounds are successfully passed to the appropriate team for development and inclusion, as applicable. Maintain the strict confidentiality of sensitive information. Travel and provide on-location support if required. Most support by UFS is accomplished without the need for travel; however, on-site support may sometimes be necessary. Perform other duties as assigned. Work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices. Observe all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Job Qualifications Typically requires a bachelors degree, masters degree or PhD in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution and progressive engineering experience as follows; four or more years of experience with a bachelors degree or two or more years of experience with a masters degree. May substitute equivalent engineering experience in lieu of education. Must have a broad understanding of multi-disciplinary engineering concepts, principles, and theory; experience demonstrating a broad application of those concepts; and expanded knowledge of principles, concepts, theory, and practices in related technical specialties. Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems. Must possess proficient technical writing skills. A writing sample may be requested. Must have excellent communication, computer, documentation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Must be able to work extended hours or weekends, as required. Must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Must be able to perform complex tasks in multiple engineering areas. Must be able to lead a team of less experienced professional employees on semi-routine tasks. Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: MQ-9A, MQ-9B, MQ-1C, Predator XP, Avenger, or other Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), to include engineering development, support, maintenance, or operations. Flight line support or System Test and Qualification (ST&Q). Design (Aero, Structures, Electrical, Propulsion, etc.). Specific aircraft, engineering, or maintainer qualifications (e.g., Airframe and Powerplant). Certification and Airworthiness. Telemetry review and analysis. Ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance is required. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 81,080 - 141,650

Manage and improve data quality through deduplication, cleansing, imports/exports, and the implementation of data governance best practices. Administer and maintain integrations between Salesforce and third-party tools (e.g., marketing automation, CPQ, experience cloud, L&D platform, Slack, AI platform). Support global sales operations including territory management, forecasting setup, pipeline reporting, and quota tracking. Collaborate with Japan and Europe teams to ensure Salesforce configurations meet regional requirements and processes. Maintain thorough documentation of system configurations, processes, customizations, and training materials. Perform training to the Sales team as needed. Data Champion: You believe that good decisions start with good data. You are obsessive about data hygiene and empower others to trust the numbers. Continuous Learner: You stay current with the Salesforce ecosystem and proactively bring new ideas and capabilities to the organization. AI-Fluent Innovator: You embrace AI as a core productivity tool and stay informed on emerging AI capabilities within Salesforce and the broader technology landscape. Excellent organisational and time-management skills Location Fully remote work within the United States (PST) or Japan Requirements 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or technology company. Proven experience supporting global or multi-regional Salesforce deployments with complex user bases and data models. Hands-on experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (formerly Community Cloud), including building and managing portals or partner/customer communities. Strong proficiency with Salesforce automation tools including Flow, Process Builder, and Workflow Rules. Experience with Salesforce integrations (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Slack, Docusign, Snowflake, or similar tools). Experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboards to support revenue operations, forecasting, and executive-level reporting. Experience leading or participating in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including writing test scripts, managing defect tracking, and coordinating stakeholder sign-off. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different time zones. review_candidates.title: Engineering Manager - Team Monetisation (f/m/d)
review_candidates.description: About Us Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches, and develops market-leading pet marketplaces globally, with over 1.5 million animals finding new homes through our platforms every year. We currently operate in 6 countries (UK, Sweden, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and the US), all within just 5 years of launching. Here's one of our apps: Pets4Homes.co.uk The way pets find new loving homes has remained largely unchanged for centuries. We're on a mission to change that through innovative technology, and increasingly through the intelligent use of AI. We're a young and ambitious team who have built unicorns before (e.g. Avito), backed by some of Europe's leading investors (e.g. Verdane and Otiva, early backers of Klarna, CAIA, Apotea, and Easypark). Who are we looking for? We're growing our Monetisation team and looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll grow and support a team of engineers, own delivery and technical direction for the Monetisation domain, and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls alongside your team. The Monetisation team works on several key parts of the business. In the VAS (value-added services) domain they build and maintain everything from pricing, checkouts and payment processing, recurring subscriptions, product activations, and experimentation/CRO. They also build and maintain an escrow system that lets users safely run the entire transaction through the platform, touching topics like KYC/KYB/identity verification, payment processing and payouts. You'll be accountable for how this team performs: the quality of what it ships, the growth of the people on it, and how the roadmap connects daily engineering work to revenue outcomes. You'll partner closely with product and the wider engineering leadership to set priorities and clear blockers. We also want someone who treats AI as a core part of how a modern team works. You encourage your engineers to use LLMs and AI tooling in their daily workflow, and you have a view on where the technology takes our ways of working. What You'll Do Lead, grow and support a team of full-stack engineers (1:1s, career development, hiring, feedback) Own delivery for the Monetisation domain: predictable, high-quality shipping against a clear roadmap Set technical direction with your team and stay hands-on enough to guide architecture and unblock hard problems Partner with product to shape priorities across VAS, payments and escrow Champion AI-assisted engineering as a standard part of how the team builds Requirements We're a fast-growing scale-up. We want teams that build fast, fail fast, and learn fast. You don't need to be a world-class expert in every tool we use, but you do need a critical, open mindset, a strong engineering background, and a genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development. Core (required): Experience managing and growing a team of software engineers, including people development and hiring Experience in the payments or fintech space (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree), or with escrow / KYC / identity verification A strong engineering background yourself, ideally full-stack with TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js and React A track record of owning delivery for a team or domain: turning strategy into a roadmap and shipping it Comfortable staying technical: reviewing designs, guiding architecture, and making trade-offs with your team Understanding of GraphQL and its usage in large systems with multiple consumers Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL Active use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Codex) in engineering work, and a point of view on how teams should adopt them Working proficiency in English is required Bonus (helpful & appreciated): Experience with monitoring & observability tools like Grafana Experience with experimentation / CRO Experience introducing or scaling AI coding workflows at team or company level Our tech stack Next.js, React, Node.js & React Native (TypeScript throughout) GitLab CI/CD Elasticsearch Redis GraphQL & PostgreSQL Knex Docker Serverless with AWS Lambda AWS Grafana Bitrise What We Offer Join a rapidly growing, already-profitable business with a clear vision and genuine energy Full ownership of a mission-critical domain and the team behind it A diverse team across Sweden, Germany, Austria, UK, Poland, Portugal, Bosnia, Croatia, Ukraine and Egypt A real opportunity to shape our tech department and help define how AI becomes part of how we build Competitive compensation and great benefits (remote or in-person) We very much look forward to your application, contact us if you have any questions!

review_candidates.title: IT Manager
review_candidates.description: Cerchiamo un IT Manager di talento cui affidare la responsabilità dell'infrastruttura tecnologica aziendale , garantendo sistemi sicuri, affidabili, efficienti e allineati agli obiettivi di business. Riportando direttamente al CIO, il candidato dovrà garantire sistemi sicuri, affidabili ed efficienti, ottimizzando il budget di reparto, negoziando i contratti con i fornitori e coordinando il team interno verso l’innovazione e il costante allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali. Collaborerà con le altre funzioni interne e con i partner esterni al fine di pianificare le strategie IT, assicurare la continuità operativa, garantire la protezione dei dati e supervisionare il servizio di Helpdesk, offrendo consulenza specialistica per l’avvio di nuovi progetti digitali. Principali responsabilità: Governa tramite il Team IT i processi informatici e relative attività allo scopo di garantire il presidio e il buon funzionamento di tutte le attività logistiche Contribuisce allo sviluppo di strategie IT a supporto della crescita, definisce e gestisce budget di reparto, contratti con fornitori esterni e licenze software Supervisiona l'installazione, configurazione e manutenzione di hardware, software e applicativi aziendali. Cura lo sviluppo delle reti di comunicazione interna/esterne, telefonia e connettività. Garantisce il costante aggiornamento tecnologico di sistemi e server aziendali. Implementa le strategie di Data Governance per valorizzare il patrimonio aziendale Implementa piani di Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, elevati standard di Cybersecurity e protocolli di back up in piena conformità con il GDPR (Reg. UE 2016/679) e D.lgs. 101/2018 Esegue la mappatura e monitora la manutenzione dell’inventario degli Asset e delle risorse IT aziendali Coordina il Team IT monitorando le performance dei progetti assegnati Monitora KPI e livelli di servizio Requisiti richiesti: Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Scienze Informatiche o diploma di scuola secondaria di secondo grado in ambito scientifico e/o informatico purché compensato da consolidata esperienza. Lingue: buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni in ruoli analoghi di Coordinamento IT. Competenze Tecniche: Solida conoscenza di architetture di rete, sicurezza informatica, sistemi ERP, normative GDPR e logiche di Data Governance e Cyber Security a tutela del patrimonio informatico. Soft Skills: attitudine alla leadership, forte orientamento al problem solving, ottime capacità di negoziazione e gestione dei fornitori e al Change Management. Propensione al miglioramento continuo e alla formazione per mantenere aggiornato il Team Orientamento al Business e all’analisi dei fabbisogni dei clienti. Capacità di gestire le priorità e di garantire la stabilità e continuità dei servizi informatici anche in situazioni di emergenza Cosa Offriamo Inserimento diretto in azienda come 1° Livello con contratto a tempo indeterminato CCNL Commercio Pacchetto retributivo: RAL compresa tra € 65.000 e € 75.000, commisurata all’effettiva esperienza e alle competenze del candidato. Il pacchetto è integrato da premi variabili basati su obiettivi aziendali e di reparto, e benefit commisurati alla posizione e all’esperienza Assistenza sanitaria integrativa come previsto dal CCNL Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, stimolante e fortemente orientato all'innovazione. Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi del D.Lgs. 198/2006, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei D.Lgs. 215/03 e 216/03
